summary.text: Trista Gomez is the Republican candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Natha Anderson.
Her professional experience includes social work, nonprofit childcare administration and real estate.

paragraphs.text: Gomez was born in Reno, Nevada, and earned an associate degree from Truckee Meadows Community College in 2000 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Reno in 2003.
Her professional experience includes working in social work and as a nonprofit childcare director, office manager and real estate broker.
Gomez ran in the June 11, 2024 Republican primary for Washoe County Commission District 4, in which incumbent Clara Andriola prevailed.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a fourth-generation Nevadan who has lived in Spanish Springs for 40 years and as the first college graduate in her family.
She listed controlling costs and regulation for families and small businesses, affordable housing, and public safety resources among her priorities.
